text:
maya: FYI — Acme checkout is failing on /invoke/payments, getting schema validation errors. Customer saw `additionalProperties` for `meta` and also a missing/nullable `amount` error. Repro payload and validator output below.
sanjay: can you paste the raw payload + validator trace?

maya: here's the exact payload they sent (redacted):
```json
{
  "order_id": "ORD-4321",
  "amount": null,
  "currency": "USD",
  "meta": {"origin": "mobile", "attempt": 1},
  "billing_profile": {"id": "cust_99"}
}
```
and the validator output from our gateway:
```
ValidationError: additionalProperties are not allowed ('meta' was unexpected) at /payload
ValidationError: 'amount' is a required property at /payload
TypeError: expected number but got null (amount)
```
This only started after client upgraded their checkout lib last week. They also reported occasional 500s with the same error message.

sanjay: repro'd locally with SDK v3.0 — same errors. Root cause: function schema disallows extra keys and requires `amount` as number. The client is sending `amount` null sometimes (guest flow) and also including `meta` from mobile. Our validator (ajv) is strict: `additionalProperties: false` on the payments function schema.

sanjay: quick options: 1) server-side shim in gateway to coerce/strip unknowns (fast hotfix), 2) make schema lenient (allow additionalProperties or add `meta`), 3) update SDK to coerce `amount` string/null -> number or block early. I can push gate shim patch now.

eli: +1 for gateway shim as emergency rollback, but we need a proper fix: add `meta` to schema or set `additionalProperties: true` for backward compatibility, then add strict schema in next major. Also add unit tests for null/str amounts.

maya: can we get a small patch we can deploy to prod ASAP? Customer is hitting checkout errors for ~7% of sessions.

sanjay: patch ready. Node snippet we used for shim:
```js
// gateway shim
if (payload.amount === null || typeof payload.amount === 'string') {
  const n = parseFloat(payload.amount);
  payload.amount = Number.isFinite(n) ? n : undefined;
}
// strip unexpected mobile metadata
if (payload.meta) delete payload.meta;
```
That makes the validator happy for their payloads. I'll open a PR and hotfix release.

runtime-bot: Incident INC-20260317-94 created and linked to thread 2764829000. Assigned to eng-oncall.

eli: add an automated regression check: send synthetic payloads (amount null, amount as string, extra meta) to payments endpoint and assert acceptance. Also add telemetry to count how many payloads have `meta` or null amounts in last 30d.

maya: I've told customer we have a hotfix in staging and will deploy within the hour. Asked them to retry after deploy.

sanjay: PR: https://git.redwood/infer/gateway/pulls/482 — includes shim + unit tests. Will coordinate canary with @eli.

maya: thanks. tagging for postmortem and docs update on SDK compatibility. :thumbsup:

eli: long-term action items: update payments function schema to accept `meta` (object) or explicitly document that gateway strips extras; add SDK warning when amount nullable. I'll add to roadmap.

maya: closing loop after canary passes.

sanjay: quick note — we should consider `coerceTypes: true` in ajv for next release to reduce these customer regressions, but need to weigh safety.

maya: ack.
